BiblicalUsage: Hadassah is Esther's Hebrew name, the name she carried before the Persian court knew her as Esther. She was Mordecai's cousin, raised by him after her parents died, and the name Hadassah marks her as a Jew before it marks her as a queen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hadassah matters because God knows His people by name, and Hadassah is one of them.
